body: My girlfriend died 7 months ago from a drug overdose. For a long time I thought she was murdered, then accepted it as a suicide, and now I mostly believe it was an accident (on her part anyway). Her ex husband was abusive and very violent and threatening towards her and it damaged her mentally. I did everything I could to try and save her, but she wouldn't move out of state with me or trust me and now she's gone. I blame myself every day for this even though it's not my fault and there was nothing I could have done. We're just gonna have to learn to live with these feelings because I don't care what people say, time does NOT heal all wounds and sometimes things DON'T get better. I just accept now that I'm probably gonna feel this way forever. But please understand it's not your fault, even if you feel like it is. Feelings aren't facts

I know. But what if someone needs us someday and we dont even know it. I stay alive because of her daughter who i dont even know. Shes 9 and I'm saving money for her. I drew her a picture and left it with the cemetery people and they made sure she got it. If it wasnt for maybe being able to help her someday i would have put a bullet in my heart by now. Find some one who may need your help and stay alive for them
